content: Yen biru Filisitibɑ bɑ ben tɑbu kowobu mɛnnɑ bɑ tɑbun sɔɔru kuɑ Sokoɔ Yudɑn temɔ. Bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ Efɛsi Dɑmimuɔ, ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Soko kɑ Asekɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɔɔlu kɑ Isirelibɑ ben tii bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ Elɑn wɔwɑ sɔɔ. Miyɑ bɑ tɑbu kpĩ bu kɑ Filisitibɑ wɔri.
Filisitibɑ bɑ yɔ̃ wɔwɑ yen berɑ ɡee, mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ mɑɑ yɔ̃ yen berɑ ɡiɔ.
Tɑbu durɔ ɡoo u yɑrimɑ Filisitibɑn sɑnsɑnin di, u dɑ u yɔ̃rɑ sɑnsɑni yiru yen bɑɑ sɔɔ. Win yĩsirɑ Goliɑti. Gɑtin diyɑ u nɑ. Mɑ win ɡunum turɑ ɡɔm soonu nɔɔbɑ tiɑ kɑ bɔnu.
U sii ɡɑndun furɔ doke, kɑ sii ɡɑndun tɑrɑkpe ye bɑ kuɑ nɡe swɑ̃ɑ kokosu. Yen bunum mu kuɑ kilo wɑtɑ.
U mɑɑ sii ɡɑndun kɔrɔm doke, mɑ u sii ɡɑndun yɑɑsɑ bɛki.
Yɑɑsɑ yen buru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe weson dɛkɑ ye u rɑ beku yɑsɑ tɛ̃ke. Yen bɛm bunum turɑ kilo nɔɔbɑ yirun sɑkɑ. Mɑ tɑbu kowo ɡoo u nùn ɡbiiye u win tɛrɛru nɛni.
Goliɑti wi, u yɔ̃rɑ u ɡbɑ̃rɑ u Isirelibɑn tɑbu kowobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i yɑrimɑ i tɑbu sĩɑ kpĩ. I ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ nɛ Filisitiwɑ, bɛɛ mɑɑ Sɔɔlun yobu? I ɡoo ɡɔsio bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ u nɑ u kɑ mɑn sɑnnɑ.
Ù n kpĩɑ u mɑn kɑmiɑ u ɡo, nɛn tɔmbu bu ko bɛɛn yobu. Adɑmɑ nɑ̀ n nùn kɑmiɑ nɑ ɡo, bɛɛyɑ ko i ko bɛsɛn yobu, kpɑ i sun sɑ̃.
Sɑnnɔwɑ nɑ kĩ ɡisɔ. I ɡoo wunɑmɑ wi u koo kɑ mɑn sɑnnɑ.
Ye Sɔɔlu kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ Filisiti win ɡɑri yi nuɑ, mɑ bɛrum bu mwɑ ɡem ɡem.
Dɑfidi wee, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isɑin bii. Isɑi wi, Efɑrɑtiɡiiwɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ Yudɑn temɔ. Bii tɔn durɔbu nɔɔbɑ itɑwɑ u mɑrɑ. Sɔɔlun wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ durɔ tɔkɔru ɡem ɡem.
Win bii bukurobu itɑ bɑ Sɔɔlu swĩi bɑ kɑ tɑbu dɑ. Ben yĩsɑ wee, Eliɑbu kɑ Abinɑdɑbu kɑ Sɑmɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Sɔɔlun sɑnsɑniɔ, win bii dɑ̃ɑko Dɑfidi
u rɑ dewɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ u kɑ win tundon yɑ̃ɑnu kpɑrɑ kpɑ u ɡɔsirɑmɑ Sɔɔlun mi.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Goliɑti wi, u rɑ nɛwɑ Isirelibɑn wuswɑɑɔ bururu kɑ yokɑ u kɑ tii bu sɔ̃ɔsi. Mɛyɑ u kuɑ sere sɔ̃ɔ weeru.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Isɑi u win bii Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡbere sɔndɑnu sɑɑki tiɑ suo kɑ pɛ̃ɛ wɔku te, kpɑ ɑ kɑ wunɛn mɑɑbu dɑɑwɑ fuuku tɑbu ɡberɔ.
A mɑɑ ɡɑsɑnu wɔku te suo ɑ ben wuurun wiruɡii wɛ̃ kpɑ ɑ wɑ nɡe bɑ̀ n bwɑ̃ɑ do, kpɑ ɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wurɑmɑ ben min di ni nu koo mɑn sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ ɑ turɑ mi.
Bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Sɔɔlu kɑ Isirelibɑn tɑbu kowobu Elɑn wɔwɑɔ. Miyɑ bɑ tɑbu mɔ̀ kɑ Filisitibɑ.

Sisiru buru buru, Dɑfidi u seewɑ u yɑ̃ɑ ni ɡoo nɔmu sɔndiɑ. Mɑ u win sɔmunu suɑ u doonɑ nɡe mɛ Isɑi u nùn yiire. Ye u turɑ mi, u deemɑ wee, tɑbu kowobɑ yɑrimɑmɔ bɑ tɑbun sɔɔru mɔ̀. Bɑ ɡbɑmɡbɑ soomɔ bɑ kuuki mɔ̀.
Isirelibɑ kɑ Filisitibɑ bɑ tɑbu tɛriɑmɔ.
Dɑfidi u win sɔmunu sɔbiɑ u yɑ̃nun kɔ̃so nɔmu bɛriɑ, mɑ u dukɑ dɑ tɑbu ɡberɔ u win mɑɑbu deemɑ u bu tɔburɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u kɑ bu ɡɑri mɔ̀, wee Filisitibɑn tɑbu durɔ Gɑtiɡii wi bɑ mɔ̀ Goliɑti u kurɑmɑ sɑɑ Filisitibɑn tɑbu sĩɑn di. U win ɡɑri yi sɑɑrim seewɑ, mɑ Dɑfidi u yi nuɑ.
Ye Isirelibɑ bɑ durɔ wi wɑ, be kpuro bɑ bɛrum soorɑ ɡem ɡem bɑ duki yɑkikirɑ.

Mɑ bɑ mɔ̀, durɔ wi wee, u mɑɑ yɑrimɑ u kɑ sun nɔɔ kɑsu. Wi u kpĩɑ u nùn ɡo, sunɔ u koo yɛ̃ro dukiɑ bɑkɑ wɛ̃, kpɑ u nùn win bii wɔndiɑ kɛ̃ kurɔ. Mɛyɑ yɛ̃ron yɛnuɡibɑ ko n tii mɔ. Sunɔ kun mɑɑ bu ɡɑ̃ɑnu bikiɑmɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ rɑ n Filisiti, bɑnɡo sɑriruɡii wi, u sere kɑ bɛsɛ Gusunɔn tɑbu kowobu nɔɔ kɑsu. Mbɑ bɑ koo yɛ̃ro wɛ̃ wi u nùn ɡo, mɑ u Isirelibɑ sekuru yɑrɑ.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye bɑ rɑɑ ɡerunɑmɔ. Bɑ nɛɛ, yeni kɑ yeniwɑ bɑ koo yɛ̃ro wɛ̃ wi u nùn ɡo.

Ye Eliɑbu Dɑfidin mɔɔ tɔnwero u nuɑ Dɑfidi u ɡɑri mɔ̀ kɑ tɔn be, u kɑ nùn mɔru kuɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ ɑ sere yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ piibu ɡe deriɑ ɡbɑburɔ. Nɑ wunɛn ɑnɑyisiru yɛ̃ kɑ wunɛn woo bɔbunu. Nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ɑ nɑ ɑ kɑ tɑbu mɛɛriwɑ.
Dɑfidi u wisɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n kuɑ. Bɑɑ ɡɑri nɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ n bikiɑ?
Mɑ u nùn biru kisi u dɑ u ɡoo ɡɑri bikiɑ. Yerɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ nɡe mɛ ɡbiikobɑ rɑɑ ɡeruɑ.
Be bɑ nuɑ ye Dɑfidi u ɡeruɑ, yerɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Sɔɔlu sɑɑriɑ. Mɑ Sɔɔlu u Dɑfidi sokusiɑ.
Dɑfidi u Sɔɔlu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku de ɡoon tororu tu kɑrɑ Filisiti win sɔ̃, yinni, kon dɑ n kɑ nùn sɑnnɑ.
Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ ɑ susi Filisiti win mi, ɑ sere kɑ nùn sɑnnɑ. Domi wunɛ bii piibuwɑ ɡinɑ. Durɔ wi, u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ sɑɑ win ɑluwɑɑsirun di.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Sɔɔlu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn tundon yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro. Gbee sunɔ, ǹ kun mɛ yɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ɡɑɑ yɑ̀ n nɑ yɑ yɑ̃ɑ teeru mwɑ yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ,
nɑ rɑ ye nɑɑ ɡirewɑ kpɑ n ye so n yɑ̃ɑ te wɔrɑ yen nɔɔn di. Yɑ̀ n mɑn sĩiremɑ yen nɔɔ ɡbiniyɑ nɑ rɑ nɛnɛ n kɑ ye so n ɡo.
Yinni nɑ yɑɑ kɔ̃si ɡoore. Nɡe mɛyɑ kon mɑɑ Filisiti bɑnɡo sɑriruɡii wini ɡo nɡe yen tiɑ, domi u Gusunɔn tɑbu kowobu nɔɔ kɑsu.
Yinni Gusunɔ wi u mɑn wɔrɑ sɑɑ ɡbee sunɔ kɑ yɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ yen min di u koo mɑɑ mɑn wɔrɑ Filisiti win nɔmɑn di. Mɑ Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, ɑ doo kpɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nun yɔ̃re.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu u win tiin tɑbu yɑ̃nu kpuro suɑ u Dɑfidi sebusiɑ. Niyɑ tɑrɑkpe kɑ sii ɡɑndun furɔ,
kɑ tɑkobi. Yen biruwɑ Dɑfidi u kookɑri kuɑ u kɑ sĩ, domi u ǹ yen dɔɔnɛ mɔ. Adɑmɑ u Sɔɔlu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ n kɑ yenibɑ kpuro sĩ, domi nɑ ǹ yen dɔɔnɛ mɔ. Mɑ u ye potɑ u yi.
Yerɑ u win dɛkɑ suɑ u dɑ u kpee ɡori nɔɔbu dɔburɑ dɑɑrɔ u yi doke win kpɑrɑ bɔɔrɔ mɑ u win kpurɑntɛɛru suɑ u susi Filisiti win mi.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Filisiti wi, u win tɛrɛ nɛnɔ ɡbiisie bɑ kɑ susimɔ bɑ dɔɔ Dɑfidin mi.
Ye Filisiti wi, u Dɑfidi mɛɛrɑ tii, u wɑ mɑ ɑluwɑɑsi kpɛmbuwɑ, tɔn swɑ̃ɑ durɔ burɔ, yerɑ u nùn ɡɛmɑ.
Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛ bɔ̃ɔwɑ ɑ kɑ sere dɛki suɑmɑ ɑ mɑn kɑsu? Yerɑ u Dɑfidi bɔ̃rusi kɑ win bũnun yĩsiru.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ susimɑ, kon de ɡunɔsu kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ yu wunɛn yɑɑ di.

Dɑfidi wi, u Filisiti wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛ wee ɑ kɑ mɑn sɑnnɔ wee kɑ tɑkobi kɑ yɑɑsɑ kɑ sɑkɑ. Adɑmɑ nɛ, nɑ kɑ nun sɑnnɔ weewɑ kɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinnin yĩsiru, wi u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn tɑbu kowobun Yinni wi ɑ nɔɔ kɑsu.

Gisɔ Yinni Gusunɔ u koo mɑn nun nɔmu bɛriɑ. Kon nun so n surɑ kpɑ n wunɛn wiru burɑ. Gisɔ kon Filisitibɑn tɑbu kowobun ɡonu ɡunɔsu kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ wɛ̃ yi di. Kpɑ hɑnduniɑɡibu kpuro bu ɡiɑ mɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u dɑm mɔ.
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mini kpuro bɑ koo wɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kun tɑkobi kɑ yɑɑsɑn bukɑtɑ mɔ u kɑ tɔnu fɑɑbɑ ko. Domi wiyɑ u rɑ tɑbu di. U koo sun bɛɛ nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Sɑɑ ye Filisiti wi, u susimɔ u kɑ Dɑfidi wɔri, sɑɑ yerɑ Dɑfidin tii u mɑɑ dukɑ dɔɔ Filisitibɑn tɑbu sĩɑɔ u kɑ nùn yinnɑ.
Mɑ u win nɔmu kpɛ̃ɛ kpɑrɑ bɔɔ te sɔɔ u kperu wunɑ u bɛri win kpurɑntɛɛru sɔɔ. Mɑ u Filisiti wi kpee te kɑrɑ tɑ dɑ tɑ numɑ win sirikɑnɑɔ mɑ u wɔrumɑ u kibɑri.
Kpurɑntɛɛrun kpee teerɑ Dɑfidi u kɑ Filisiti wi kɑmiɑ. Ye u nùn surɑ bɑɑ tɑkobi u ǹ nɛni.
Mɑ u dukɑ dɑ u durɔ win tɑkobi womɑ yen kɑrɑrun di u kɑ nùn ɡo u wiru burɑ. Ye Filisitibɑ bɑ wɑ mɑ ben tɑbu durɔ wi, u ɡu, yerɑ bɑ duki yɑrinɑ.

Yerɑ Isirelibɑn tɑbu durɔbu kɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ Filisitibɑ fɛɛrisi kɑ tɑbun wurenu bɑ bu ɡirɑ sere Gɑti kɑ Ekoronin kɔnnɔwɔ, mɑ Filisitibɑn ɡonu wɔrukɑ Sɑɑrɑimun swɑɑɔ sere kɑ Gɑtiɔ n kɑ ɡirɑri Ekoroniɔ.
Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ bɑ Filisitibɑn sɑnsɑni wɔri bɑ ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ.
Yen biru Dɑfidi u Goliɑtin wiru suɑ u kɑ dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Adɑmɑ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ Goliɑtin tɑbu yɑ̃nu kpuro u ni yiwɑ win tiin kurɔ.
Yonɑtɑm
u kɑ Dɑfidi bɔrɔnu kuɑ
Sɑɑ ye Sɔɔlu u Dɑfidi wɑ u dɔɔ u kɑ Filisiti wi sɑnnɑ, yerɑ u win tɑbu sunɔ Abinɛɛ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Abinɛɛ, weren biiwɑ bii durɔbu ɡeni. Abinɛɛ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru, nɑ ǹ yɛ̃.
Mɑ sunɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ bikio kpɑ ɑ nɔ ǹ n weren biin nɑ.
Ye Dɑfidi u Filisiti wi ɡo u kpɑ u win wiru burɑ u nɛni u kɑ wee, yerɑ Abinɛɛ u kɑ nùn dɑ Sɔɔlun mi.
Sɔɔlu u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bii wunɛ, weren biiwɑ wunɛ. Dɑfidi u nɛɛ, Isɑi, wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ, wiyɑ u mɑn mɑrɑ.
